title: Prediction: changes in relevant prefrontal activity suffice for changes in awareness

statements.text: The higher-order view predicts that changes in the relevant prefrontal and parietal activity suffice for changes in awareness, though only a small subset of that activity carries higher-order representations. It does not tie awareness to perceptual performance or to higher cognitive functions.
statements.falsification_criteria: Awareness that differs with matched first-order states and performance and no difference in prefrontal activity, or selective disruption of the relevant prefrontal regions that leaves subjective reports and metacognition intact.

sources.quote: higher-order representations probably constitute only a small subset of such activity
